compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from the "Enterprise CarShare" app. The main contents and functions available on this screen include:

1. **Reservations**: Allows users to make or view car reservations.
2. **24/7 Customer Support**: Provides access to customer support services at any time.
3. **Report an Accident**: Enables users to report an accident involving a car share vehicle.
4. **Send App Feedback**: Option to send feedback about the app.
5. **Log In**: Allows users to log into their account.
6. **Privacy Policy**: Link to the app's privacy policy.
7. **Terms of Use**: Link to the app's terms of use.

The screen also displays the app's name at the top and the current time and status icons at the very top.
